title: Tencent Hunyuan UniCom
summary: UniCom is a unified multimodal framework that bridges visual understanding and generation using compressed continuous semantic representations. It integrates SigLIP2 for visual representation and Flux VAE for high-quality image reconstruction, enabling consistent editing and generation.
research_notes: Performs generation directly over compressed visual embeddings rather than raw pixels; combines the strengths of SigLIP2 and Flux architectures.

evolution.summary: UniCom represents the unification of Tencent's understanding and generation pipelines into a single framework. As of mid-2026, it remains the core multimodal foundation for the Hunyuan ecosystem, which has expanded into reasoning-focused models like Hy3-preview and advanced 3D generation with Hunyuan3D 3.0.
